subject: SPANISH 1
caption: Ser or estar? Two memory tricks end the guessing: DR. ROPPMEET for ser and CLEPPP for estar. Save this for your next Spanish quiz. Free Spanish 1 study guide with 20 ser vs estar practice questions at precisstudy.com/spanish-1 (no sign-up).

slides.title: ESTAR = CLEPPP
slides.note: States, places, and -ing actions take ESTAR.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
steps: A party is an Event: the E in ROPPMEET.
slides.answer: La fiesta ES en el parque.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
steps: A person's place is Location: the L in CLEPPP.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: La fiesta está en el parque
points: Events take ser, even though the party sounds like a place.
Estás aburrido = you are bored. Eres aburrido = you are boring.

pageTitle: Ser vs Estar: DR. ROPPMEET, CLEPPP and Examples
description: Ser or estar? Use two memory tricks, DR. ROPPMEET and CLEPPP, to pick the right verb, with worked examples and a common mistake to avoid.
